body.intent: Fix rhiza run resume --retry cannot rebuild a leaf that used up its attempts: after its blocker was fixed, retrying ship-change run 01M6W86NY11Z (change set 01M6VY7H9PYX, autonomy per workflow) re-ran build/build at 03:49Z, which failed at once ('5 of 6 leaves passed; not passed: bugfix-workflow-autonomous') with no new builder attempt, because the leaf's 6 attempts were spent while it was blocked on workflow dispatch (question bugfix-needs-workflow-dispatch, since answered and main merged in). The only way on was rhiza run abandon plus a new run. A retry of a build step should give each failed leaf a fresh attempt budget, at least when the blocking question has been answered or the branch has moved since the last attempt.
